name: Lemony Olive Braised Chicken
steps:
Pour the olive oil into a heavy-based saucepan and place over the
lowest heat. Add the chicken thighs, skin-side down (you may need
to do this in batches). Cook for 10 mins until the chicken skin is
very crispy and the fat has rendered out. Remove the chicken and
set aside on a plate.

Meanwhile, dice the onion and slice the garlic. Juice 2/3 the lemons (you want 100ml of lemon juice) and thinly slice the remaining lemon. Break apart the olives with your fingers, removing the stones. Drain the butterbeans, keeping the liquid.

Add the onion to the chicken fat and cook for 5 mins over
a medium-high heat until lightly golden. Add the garlic, black
peppercorns and turmeric and cook for 2 mins more.
Pour in the white wine to deglaze the pan and let the alcohol cook off for 5 mins, or until the onions are sticky.

Add the butter beans into the pan with the chicken stock, lemon juice, lemon slices and olives. Top with the chicken, skin side up. Cover and cook for 15-20 mins until the chicken is cooked through. Taste and season with salt and pepper, if needed. Add a splash of bean liquid, if you'd like a runnier sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper before serving with warm crusty bread. Enjoy!
